name: ANSI/IEEE Frequency monitoring relay form
summary: IEEE-library form of frequency monitoring relay: a frequency relay issues a documented output for a configured frequency condition.
description: This reference locates frequency monitoring relay in Autodesk's IEEE-oriented miscellaneous relays family. A frequency relay issues a documented output for a configured frequency condition. The schematic identifies its measurement input and links its thresholds to the settings record. The public library uses HCR1F40 for its horizontal representation; this is a vendor block name, not an IEEE standards symbol number.

Trace the measured quantity or initiating control signal separately from the output contacts. The device tag links the sensing or operating element to the controlled circuit; settings, reset behaviour and the actual terminal arrangement belong in the selected equipment documentation.

Determine whether high frequency, low frequency or both are monitored. A frequency relay applies operating criteria; a frequency meter only indicates the measured value. The linked functional counterpart explains the same operating role in its own drawing context; agreement of every detailed convention mark is not asserted.
